MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable and SanDisk memory card fit my repeated purchases of cables, adapters, and storage that help me keep using equipment I already own.",
    "A Fire TV Stick offers a useful new function for my Samsung TV, so streaming feels like a plausible next step even though my 720p screen would not benefit from 4K."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and smart plug introduce voice control and home automation, which are not needs expressed by my tablet or power-strip purchases.",
    "My tripods, lens cap, and camera memory cards support photography; they do not mean I want an indoor monitoring camera.",
    "Several streaming devices fit the same possible need, but I would choose only one; interest in one does not make the others additional purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a broader range of Amazon devices, although I choose accessories for specific uses.",
    "Broad connections such as cameras to monitoring cameras and power accessories to smart plugs overlook the different purposes those products serve."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Memory cards and practical accessories recur throughout my history, making compatible replacements and spares especially relevant.",
    "Compatibility matters: my TV is 720p, and a memory card is useful only if it works with my equipment.",
    "My latest lens-cap purchase continues a longstanding interest in camera accessories that receives little attention here."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in useful electronics accessories but stretch it into an unsupported interest in voice control and home automation."
}
